mapper.select: SELECT * FROM goal WHERE ucode = #{ucode} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goal (ucode, mode, status, start_weight, target_weight, start_body_fat_pct, target_body_fat_pct, start_muscle_mass_kg, target_muscle_mass_kg, ai_regen_cost) VALUES (#{ucode}, #{mode}, 'ACTIVE', #{startWeight}, #{targetWeight}, #{startBodyFatPct}, #{targetBodyFatPct}, #{startMuscleMassKg}, #{targetMuscleMassKg}, 30)
mapper.update: UPDATE goal SET mode = #{mode}, start_weight = #{startWeight}, target_weight = #{targetWeight}, start_body_fat_pct = #{startBodyFatPct}, target_body_fat_pct = #{targetBodyFatPct}, start_muscle_mass_kg = #{startMuscleMassKg}, target_muscle_mass_kg = #{targetMuscleMassKg}, status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE goal_seq = #{goalSeq}
